integrity: The exact coefficient identities and analytic proof establish the all-parameter statement; check.py provides repeatable independent finite checks and is not itself an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Isotropic Dirichlet-type bidisk norms with alpha >= 0; symmetric bidegree-at-most (1,1) generators with nonzero constant term; degree-one optimal polynomial approximants. No general higher-degree exclusion theorem. Literature priority remains bounded rather than exhaustive.
title: Sharp zero-exclusion radius for symmetric multiaffine bidisk approximants
